title: [P2] Refresh DeSpoilerize page for published v1.1.0 and current viewing controls
body:
## Problem and verified status

Audit of https://anthonypwatts.co.uk/projects/despoilerize/ on **17 October 2026**, covering every section, the three-slide gallery, resource links and social metadata.

The page's engineering account is largely accurate, but visitors cannot see its current release or install it directly. Entertainment coverage is vague, and the popup screenshot explicitly says **v0.5.1**.

The [public Chrome Web Store listing](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/despoilerize/ekckhdeeoilbnocmcpnhbcocbapjpmof) now shows **1.1.0**, with **Updated 28 September 2026**. This is the store's displayed update date, not proof of an exact approval time. Local and remote main at `0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7` also use 1.1.0. The [GitHub latest release](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/releases/latest) is still v0.5.4: do not use that redirect for the current installer or describe v1.1 as the latest GitHub release.

**Source documentation is stale:** the extension README and release index still call v0.5.4 current and v1.1 pending review. Use the live store for publication status, and the source below for behaviour. A separate DeSpoilerize documentation issue will track that inconsistency.

## Areas requiring changes

| Page area | Finding | Required update |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hero / availability | No visible version, publication status or installation route | Show v1.1.0 and a clearly labelled Chrome Web Store install link near the opening. A checked date may be used; avoid an undated claim of “latest”. |
| Motivation / scope | The F1 origin remains useful, but “other sport and entertainment” does not explain current coverage | Keep the first-person origin; name the dedicated Big Brother and The Traitors packs alongside representative sports. |
| Viewing workflow | Configurable schedules are mentioned without explaining current controls | Add a short practical account: choose topics, choose schedule/sensitivity, browse, reveal intentionally, then use I'm caught up. |
| Session completion | I'm caught up and Return to schedule are absent | Explain immediate session end, protection clearing on open pages, saved choices remaining, and the next scheduled start. Weekend means the next Saturday; daily/custom means the next start. Always-on/manual protection requires deliberate reactivation. Return to schedule cancels the ended-session state. |
| Settings | The page does not explain automatic saving, temporary overrides or per-site controls | State that changes save automatically; temporary popup protection does not replace the saved schedule; filtering can be disabled independently for supported sites. Mention custom terms concisely. Avoid adding a Save step. |
| Protection packs | No dedicated pack examples or maintained-data context | State that Big Brother and The Traitors can be selected independently of Reality TV. Sports/cast data are bundled, audited in September 2026 and include retained catch-up names; they do not update from live calendars. An optional count is 22 packs at the audited ref, not 22 websites. |
| Detection / examples | Balanced/Lockdown explanations and existing examples remain accurate; Gentle is omitted | Name all three modes without claiming guaranteed detection. Explain that Lockdown also hides topic-only matches. Common contestant first names require programme context. Preserve the existing safe-preview examples. |
| Limitations | Existing false-positive/blur caveats are good, but new episode examples could imply automatic progress tracking | Add a concise boundary: no watched-episode tracking, upload-date filtering, image-text/face recognition or official event-calendar integration. A clear episode in a screenshot is a deliberate reveal. |
| Source and tests | Repository and two test links are valid, but there is no consumer installation, privacy-policy or support route | Retain source/test links, add the store, [privacy policy](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/PRIVACY.md) and [issue tracker](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/issues). Use store install for ordinary use, README for unpacked development. Do not imply a separate Edge Add-ons listing has been verified. |
| Gallery, preview images and captions | Old UI, sport-only imagery and generic “Extension release” captions | Coordinate with the companion screenshot issue: v1.1 genuine captures, explicit mode/reveal captions, provenance, matching alt text and responsive derivatives. |
| Metadata / related summaries | Description and social text are generic; social image/alt still describe the old BBC capture | Align description, OG and Twitter text with sport + reality TV coverage. Keep metadata concise and avoid baking a fast-staling version into the title. Update image references/alt/dimensions with the media change. Check homepage and directory DeSpoilerize summaries for consistency; no broader portfolio rewrite. |

## Suggested copy anchors

Availability: **“v1.1.0 is available in the Chrome Web Store.”** Link “Install DeSpoilerize” to the store above.

Session behaviour: **“When I have finished watching, I'm caught up ends this protection session without changing my topics or schedule. Protection returns at the next scheduled start; Return to schedule lets me undo that choice.”** Add the always-on/manual exception beside it.

Scope: **“Dedicated Big Brother and The Traitors packs sit alongside Formula 1, football and other sports. Custom terms cover shows, teams or events that do not have a dedicated pack.”**

Retain the site's existing first-person voice, UK English, restrained design and engineering focus. This is a focused content refresh.

## Source evidence

- [v1.1 changes and verification record](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/Releases/v1.1/README.md) — use behaviour details; submission status is historical.
- [Actual settings UI](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/src/options/index.html), [popup UI](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/src/popup/index.html), [pack registry](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/src/rules/index.ts).
- [Big Brother coverage](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/docs/big-brother-pack.md), [The Traitors coverage](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/docs/traitors-pack.md), [pack audit and limits](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/docs/pack-data.md).
- [Scheduling and session behaviour](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/README.md#ending-a-protection-session).
- [Settings use browser sync](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/src/shared/storage.ts), [privacy policy](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/PRIVACY.md).

The current supported-site list (Google Search, Google News, BBC, The Guardian, YouTube), local page-content processing, browser-managed settings sync, no extension account/backend/AI API/analytics, and fixture-versus-live-test distinction are already accurate. Preserve them. Do not invent accuracy figures, user adoption or broader site coverage.

Existing **#20** already owns a source-backed regression investigation. Keep that separate; this refresh should not create another case-study backlog item. DeSpoilerize #5 is a usable evidence source if that issue is later implemented, but the original personalised-feed failure sequence was not captured.

## Implementation and acceptance

Primary file: `public/projects/despoilerize/index.html`; related snippets in `public/index.html` and `public/projects/index.html` only where needed. Update the relevant documentation and existing validator expectations if they change.

- [ ] Publication and install route match the live store at implementation time; store and GitHub release states remain distinct.
- [ ] Current packs, session controls, auto-save and key limitations are explained accurately.
- [ ] Privacy, supported-site and detection trade-offs remain intact.
- [ ] Content, gallery captions, preview metadata and related summaries agree.
- [ ] Any new in-page section appears in the contents navigation and retains working anchors.
- [ ] Preserve concurrent local edits; the website checkout had substantial unrelated work in progress during the audit.
- [ ] Use the existing asset build; run `npm run build:assets`, `npm test` and `git diff --check`.
- [ ] Inspect desktop and 390/320px layouts in both appearances, including link focus, anchors and gallery controls; verify ordinary content links with JavaScript disabled. Report checks actually performed.

This audit did not change or deploy the website or rerun the extension test suites. No new dependencies are needed.

## Linked delivery issues

- [#36 — current screenshots, responsive assets and social previews](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/AnthonyPWatts.co.uk/issues/36)
- [DeSpoilerize #7 — correct stale source publication status](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/issues/7)

title: [P2] Replace DeSpoilerize v0.5.1 imagery with verified v1.1 screenshots and previews
body:
Companion to **#35** (content, availability and viewing controls). Audit date: **17 October 2026**.

## Why the images need updating

The current three-slide gallery uses:
- `public/assets/projects/despoilerize-live-protection.png`: an undated BBC football capture; it does not demonstrate current entertainment coverage.
- `despoilerize-popup.png`: explicitly **v0.5.1**, lacking I'm caught up and current session state.
- `despoilerize-settings.png`: older schedule presentation without I'm caught up.
- Generic “Extension release · 01/02/03” labels and captions, with no version/capture provenance.

The homepage and directory reuse `despoilerize-protection-preview.png`, derived from that BBC capture. The project page's OG/Twitter image and image-alt fields also describe the BBC capture. Refresh all these consumers together; replacing only a PNG will leave stale WebP candidates and metadata.

## Prepared handoff

Generated locally, outside the dirty website checkout:

`C:\_Source\Despoilerize\docs\website-refresh-2026-10-17\`

Contains `assets/`, `asset-manifest.json` (dimensions, hashes, pinned source URLs and every transformation), `prepare_assets.py`, `issues.json`, a browsable `handoff.html` and `despoilerize-website-refresh.zip`.

**11 PNGs + 31 WebP variants** are prepared. Nine PNGs are byte-for-byte copies of verified existing captures. Two are explicitly documented derivatives: a thumbnail crop and a labelled popup comparison. All files decode; no image or UI text has been AI-generated.

The generated handoff is versioned in the DeSpoilerize repository under `docs/website-refresh-2026-10-17/`; the published issue includes pinned download and file links. Implementation must copy the required images into the website repository, rather than hotlinking GitHub or relying on a local absolute path in deployed HTML. The immutable original-source links and transformation instructions below are retained for provenance.

## Asset mapping and captions

All full-page source captures are **1280 × 800**. Capture date is **27 September 2026**, running v1.1.0 in a fresh signed-out Chrome for Testing profile. These are retained historical captures, not new live browsing evidence from October.

| Prepared PNG | Public original | Purpose / accurate caption |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `despoilerize-f1-reveal.png` | [03-youtube-reveal-once.png](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/Releases/v1.1/screenshots/live/03-youtube-reveal-once.png) | Formula 1 in Lockdown: one highlights result deliberately revealed; other matching results stay protected. |
| `despoilerize-big-brother-reveal.png` | [08-big-brother-reveal-once.png](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/Releases/v1.1/screenshots/live/08-big-brother-reveal-once.png) | Big Brother in Lockdown: episode 11 deliberately revealed; episode 12 stays protected. This is a viewer choice, not automatic episode tracking. |
| `despoilerize-settings-schedule.png` | [04-protection-schedule.png](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/Releases/v1.1/screenshots/live/04-protection-schedule.png) | Weekend schedule and I'm caught up in the current settings UI. Settings save automatically. |
| `despoilerize-settings-topics.png` | [05-protected-topics.png](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/Releases/v1.1/screenshots/live/05-protected-topics.png) | Grouped sport/entertainment packs and custom terms. Entertainment is collapsed here; use the detail images to show the dedicated choices. |
| `despoilerize-popup-active.png` | [details/protection-popup.png](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/Releases/v1.1/screenshots/live/details/protection-popup.png) | Native **450 × 625** popup: temporary protection active, saved weekend schedule unchanged, I'm caught up available. It shows an override, not a naturally active scheduled weekend. |
| `despoilerize-popup-caught-up.png` | [details/caught-up-popup.png](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/Releases/v1.1/screenshots/live/details/caught-up-popup.png) | Native **450 × 587** popup: session ended; next scheduled protection shown, saved schedule unchanged. Relative dates are from the September capture. |
| `despoilerize-traitors-pack.png` | [details/traitors-pack.png](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/Releases/v1.1/screenshots/live/details/traitors-pack.png) | Native **266 × 341** Entertainment card with The Traitors selected independently. |
| `despoilerize-big-brother-pack.png` | [details/big-brother-pack.png](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/Releases/v1.1/screenshots/live/details/big-brother-pack.png) | Native **266 × 341** Entertainment card with Big Brother selected independently. |
| `despoilerize-protection-social.png` | [02-youtube-protection-on.png](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/Releases/v1.1/screenshots/live/02-youtube-protection-on.png) | 1280 × 800 F1 results with protection on. Suitable replacement for the BBC social image; update BBC-specific alt text. |
| `despoilerize-protection-preview.png` | Crop of 02 above | **576 × 248**, real warning + both reveal controls over a protected thumbnail. Intended for the existing bounded homepage/directory preview slots. |
| `despoilerize-popup-states.png` | Composition of both native popup PNGs above | **1280 × 800**, labelled “Protection active” and “Session ended”. Caption as a side-by-side comparison of two actual popup captures, not a single screenshot. |

Suggested five-slide gallery: **F1 reveal → Big Brother reveal → popup comparison → schedule → topics**. The two Entertainment details can sit next to the pack explanation instead of becoming unreadably small full-width slides. Keep popup/detail originals available for readable enlargement; native portrait images must not be stretched to landscape proportions.

Suggested gallery provenance: **“DeSpoilerize v1.1.0, captured on 27 September 2026 in a fresh signed-out Chrome profile. Examples use Lockdown; visible results were deliberately revealed.”** Identify the popup slide as a comparison composition.

## Reproducing the derivatives elsewhere

1. Download the nine originals via the table. For raw bytes, replace `github.com/…/blob/` with `raw.githubusercontent.com/…/`; [example raw F1 image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/Releases/v1.1/screenshots/live/03-youtube-reveal-once.png).
2. Preview crop: take rectangle **(left 88, top 104, right 664, bottom 352)** from `02-youtube-protection-on.png`; right and bottom are exclusive. Keep native scale, giving exactly 576 × 248. No replacement blur/text or retouching.
3. Popup comparison: 1280 × 800 RGB canvas, background **#0e1118**. Paste the active 450 × 625 PNG at **(140,100)** and caught-up 450 × 587 PNG at **(690,100)** without scaling. Labels at **(140,49)** and **(690,49)** use Segoe UI 25px, **#f3f1ed**. If the font is unavailable, prefer the two originals in semantic HTML rather than inventing popup text.
4. Use the website's existing `scripts/render_image_variants.py` once the new originals are referenced in the page. The prepared variants follow its smaller-of-quality-90/lossless convention, with proportional Lanczos resizing and no upscaling. Full-page widths: 480/640/960/1280; preview: 240/480/576; native details retain their own widths.

[Source gallery and capture methodology](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/Releases/v1.1/screenshots/live/README.md), [machine-readable capture record](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/blob/0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7/Releases/v1.1/screenshots/live/capture.json). The sources already exist on remote main at the pinned ref. No fresh thumbnail search, personal-profile capture, fabricated browser frame or generated product screenshot is required.

## Website integration and acceptance

- [ ] Replace the old popup/settings/gallery images with current assets and meaningful version/subject labels, alt text and captions.
- [ ] Keep F1 and entertainment examples; explain Lockdown and intentional reveals without implying automatic watched-episode or upload-date filtering.
- [ ] Show the native popup states/readable originals; do not crop controls or stretch images.
- [ ] Update the homepage/directory preview, its 240/480/576 variants and their `srcset`/intrinsic dimensions.
- [ ] Update gallery responsive variants and `sizes`; no old screenshot survives through a stale WebP candidate.
- [ ] Update OG/Twitter image URLs, alt text and real dimensions. Preserve the canonical URL.
- [ ] Correct the gallery count from three to the implemented count, both visual and screen-reader text. Check previous/next bounds, captions and no-JavaScript fallback.
- [ ] Record provenance in the site's documentation, distinguishing exact copies, the crop and the comparison. Original September dates stay truthful.
- [ ] Keep the existing site typography, light/dark appearance, bounded preview layout, image loading and gallery interaction. No new carousel/image dependency.
- [ ] Follow current repository guidance and preserve concurrent edits. Run `npm run build:assets`, `npm test`, `git diff --check`.
- [ ] Visually check all selected slides and previews at desktop, 390px and 320px in both appearances, plus readable full-size images and keyboard gallery controls. Confirm no layout shift, horizontal overflow or screenshot colour filtering.

Related #32 already established the compact preview treatment; this issue changes the underlying DeSpoilerize evidence, not portfolio layout. #20 remains the separate regression-case-study enhancement.

## Audit verification boundary

Live project page, all three captions and metadata were inspected; existing website PNGs were opened and compared with current v1.1 captures. Generated files were decoded and inspected; nine unchanged copies were hash-checked. This audit did not install the store extension, recapture YouTube, modify the website or run its implementation checks.

Source publication-status correction: [DeSpoilerize #7](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/issues/7).

title: Correct current release documentation now that Chrome Web Store publishes v1.1.0
body:
## Verified discrepancy — 17 October 2026

The [public Chrome Web Store listing](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/despoilerize/ekckhdeeoilbnocmcpnhbcocbapjpmof), checked in the browser, shows **Version 1.1.0**, **Updated 28 September 2026**, and the current Big Brother / The Traitors / I'm caught up description.

At audited main `0a57c9e954bc2d83cd9582bdbfa843751f9506f7`:
- `README.md` and `Releases/README.md` still describe v0.5.4 as the current published extension.
- `README.md`, `Releases/README.md` and `Releases/v1.1/README.md` still describe v1.1.0 as pending store review.
- `manifest.json` and `package.json` already correctly use 1.1.0.
- The [latest GitHub release](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/Despoilerize/releases/latest) remains **v0.5.4**, confirmed via the GitHub API. Store publication and GitHub release publication are distinct.

The personal website refresh is tracked in [website #35](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/AnthonyPWatts.co.uk/issues/35) and [website #36](https://github.com/AnthonyPWatts/AnthonyPWatts.co.uk/issues/36). Those agents must not copy the stale pending-review status.

## Requested correction

- [ ] Update the current-release summaries to v1.1.0, with a dated link to the live store.
- [ ] Add a current status above the historical 27 September submission record in `Releases/v1.1/README.md`. Preserve the authentic submission history, package checksums and verification record.
- [ ] Treat “Updated 28 September” as the store's displayed date; do not invent an exact approval/publication timestamp.
- [ ] Keep the still-older GitHub latest-release status explicit. Do not create a tag/release, push, or republish the package as part of this documentation-only issue without separate authorisation.
- [ ] Preserve historical v0.5/v1.0 preparation facts; add supersession/current-status context where necessary rather than rewriting them as if already published at the time.
- [ ] Review open #5's pending-release wording. Store availability of the included fix is now verified, but normal installed-browser behaviour is still a separate requirement; do not close #5 solely from the version listing.
- [ ] Check relative links, consistent version wording and `git diff --check`. Extension runtime/build changes and dependency updates are outside this issue.

## Verification boundary

Public store metadata, source metadata and GitHub release metadata were checked. No installed extension version, automatic upgrade, live YouTube regression or store package byte identity was verified in this audit. The store's 1.1.0 listing alone does not establish those behaviours.
